entry.title: New: Resolution 180 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAIʻI OFFICE OF RESEARCH SERVICES

Allows the County to provide a $14,805 grant to the College of Tropical Agriculture and Human Resources to support its Master Food Volunteer Program.
